text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
—You walked right into the trap I 
carefully laid for you.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: With this, victory is mine!!
『YOU LOSE』

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? I lost?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, wait a sec... What kind of 
game-breaking card is that...?!"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"At the very, very end! With zero strategy 
whatsoever! Just a terrible, desperate 
gamble left entirely up to luck!"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: How boring!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: ...and that's what happened!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Sigh... What a stupid way to lose after 
putting so much serious thought into my 
strategy.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, remembering it just bummed me out 
even more.
choice_data_list:
So you're saying their strategy was 
amazing?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: No way! That's not a strategy!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I just entrusted my fate to the Joker I 
luckily drew at the edge of the cliff. I 
threw the strategy out the window!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
A magnificent bout of recklessness. 
Utterly dull.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: What a complete waste of time!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Dammit! Just remembering it is pissing me 
off!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Oh, let's add dessert too.
choice_data_list: You're eating a lot today, huh?

You're eating quite a lot today, aren't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Hm? Ah... "healing of the heart," right.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I took way too much heavy damage. I just 
wanna eat something and fill myself up.
choice_data_list:

it

Watch your calorie intake and don't overdo 
it, okay?
In that case... let's eat a ton!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"...If you say so, then there's no helping 
it. Instead—"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Why don't you hear me out thoroughly until 
I'm good and satisfied?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, quite so. This "recovery" is the 
very stepping stone to a comeback.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, tonight I'll definitely win. I'll 
master even luck itself and seize 
victory!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"To do that, we've gotta make sure we're 
fully fueled up!"

And so, Rulership devoured a massive 
amount of junk food.
